name: MonarchAiSpendCap
title: AiSpendCap
wrapsNative: Card with androidx.compose.material3.LinearProgressIndicator in the tone of the state, MonarchStatusBadge, MonarchInlineNotice, and an inline form of MonarchCurrencyInput, MonarchSelect, MonarchRadioCardGroup and MonarchButtons; removal is confirmed in androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog
summary: A spending limit for AI usage: what has been spent against the limit this period, whether that is fine, close or reached, and a form to change the limit, when to warn and what happens at the limit.
whenToUse: In workspace or account settings where an admin sets how much AI may spend per day, week or month, and where people check how much is left.
whenNotToUse: Not for token or credit usage without money, which is MonarchAiUsageMeter. Not for plan quotas of a subscription, which is MonarchUsageMeter.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable public fun MonarchAiSpendCap(spent: Long, limit: Long?, currencyCode: String, period: MonarchAiSpendCapPeriod, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, unit: MonarchAiSpendCapUnit = MonarchAiSpendCapUnit.Minor, warnAt: Double = MonarchAiSpendCapTokens.DEFAULT_WARN_AT, behavior: MonarchAiSpendCapBehavior = MonarchAiSpendCapBehavior.Pause, resetsAtMillis: Long? = null, breakdown: List<MonarchAiSpendCapBreakdownItem> = emptyList(), maxLimit: Long? = null, warnAtOptions: List<Double> = MonarchAiSpendCapTokens.DefaultWarnAtOptions, editing: Boolean? = null, onEditingChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, canEdit: Boolean = true, saving: Boolean = false, timeZone: String? = null, labels: MonarchAiSpendCapLabels = MonarchAiSpendCapLabels(), onSave: ((MonarchAiSpendCapSettings) -> Unit)? = null, onRequestIncrease: (() -> Unit)? = null)
public data class MonarchAiSpendCapSettings(limit: Long?, warnAt: Double, behavior: MonarchAiSpendCapBehavior)
public class MonarchAiSpendCapBreakdownItem(id: String, label: String, spent: Long)
public enum class MonarchAiSpendCapPeriod { Day, Week, Month }
public enum class MonarchAiSpendCapBehavior { Pause, Notify }
public enum class MonarchAiSpendCapState { Ok, Warning, Reached, NoLimit }
public enum class MonarchAiSpendCapUnit { Minor, Micros }

public class MonarchAiSpendCapLabels(title, period, state, spentOfLimit, spentNoLimit, meterLabel, remaining, over, warnsAt, behaviorSummary, resets, breakdownLabel, edit, setLimit, pausedTitle, pausedBody, raiseLimit, requestIncrease, readOnly, amountLabel, amountHint, errorRequired, errorPositive, errorMax, belowSpent, warnAtLabel, warnAtOption, behaviorLabel, behaviorOption, behaviorDescription, save, saveAnyway, cancel, removeLimit, removeConfirmTitle, removeConfirmBody, removeCancel, announce), every parameter nullable with a null default

options.name: spent
options.description: Spent so far this period, as an integer in unit. Negative values count as zero.

options.name: limit
options.description: The limit as an integer in unit, or null when none is set.

options.name: currencyCode
options.description: The ISO 4217 code of every amount.

options.name: period
options.description: The window the limit applies to: day, week or month.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the card.

options.name: unit
options.description: What the integers count: the currency's minor unit, or micros (millionths of the major unit).

options.name: warnAt
options.description: The share of the limit at which the state becomes warning.

options.name: behavior
options.description: What happens at the limit: pause and ask, or keep going and tell.

options.name: resetsAtMillis
options.description: When the period starts again, in epoch milliseconds (UTC); shown with the day and month, and the time for a daily limit.

options.name: breakdown
options.description: Spending per agent or feature, listed under the bar.

options.name: maxLimit
options.description: The highest limit this person may set.

options.name: warnAtOptions
options.description: The warn-at choices; the current value is always offered, values outside 0 to 1 are left out.

options.name: editing
options.description: Whether the form is open, when the app controls it. Kept inside, closed at first, when null.

options.name: onEditingChange
options.description: Called when the form opens or closes.

options.name: canEdit
options.description: Whether this person may change the limit. false shows a read-only note and no form.

options.name: saving
options.description: Shows Save as busy and disables the form while the app saves.

options.name: timeZone
options.description: The time zone of the reset date. An IANA id such as Europe/Berlin; null, or an id the device does not know, is the device's zone.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string.

options.name: onSave
options.description: Runs with the new settings on Save, or with a null limit once removal is confirmed; the form then closes. Nothing is applied by the component.

options.name: onRequestIncrease
options.description: For people who cannot edit: adds "Request a higher limit".

states.name: ok
states.description: "Within limit" in a neutral badge and a muted bar.

states.name: warning
states.description: "Close to the limit" in a warning badge and a warning bar.

states.name: reached
states.description: "Limit reached" in a danger badge and a full danger bar; with Pause, a danger notice says AI is paused and offers Raise limit, or Request a higher limit for people who cannot edit.

states.name: no limit
states.description: "No limit set", no bar, and Set a limit instead of Edit limit.

states.name: editing
states.description: The amount field, the warn-at choice, the behavior cards, Remove limit, Cancel and Save.

states.name: below spent
states.description: A limit below what is spent shows a warning notice and Save becomes Save anyway; saving the same amount again confirms.

states.name: invalid
states.description: An empty, zero, negative or too-high amount shows an error on the field.

states.name: saving
states.description: Save shows its loading state and the form is disabled.

states.name: read only
states.description: "Only a workspace admin can change this limit.", with Request a higher limit when given.

appearance: A card on the surface color with the subtle border and the large radius; the state is a small status badge in its tone, the amount line is strong default text, the bar's track is the emphasis background and its fill the accent, warning or danger solid role, facts and the breakdown caption are muted captions. Every color is a theme role, so it follows light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Same parameters as iOS where Compose allows: isEditing as a Binding becomes editing with onEditingChange, isSaving is saving, resetsAt is resetsAtMillis (epoch milliseconds, as Monarch for Android takes every date), and the integers are Long. The web builds the form with a native select and a radio group and confirms removal inline; Android uses MonarchSelect for the warn-at choice, MonarchRadioCardGroup for the behavior, and a Material 3 AlertDialog for removal, as iOS uses a confirmationDialog. The amount field is MonarchCurrencyInput in minor units, which accepts only numbers, so the web's "not an amount" error does not arise; amounts in micros are rounded to the currency's digits in the field. The web's children slot is left out; place content beside the card. The bar is a Material 3 LinearProgressIndicator coloured by the state, without Material's track gap and stop dot. The state badge shows the web's state glyph and the Edit limit button the web's pencil, both bundled by Monarch. Times use the configuration locale and an optional timeZone in place of the web's locale and timeZone props. The composable is experimental: an AI settings pattern that waits for a Rook app to adopt it.
accessibility: The title is a heading and the card is one traversal group.
The state is a word in a status badge, never color alone.
The bar is named "Spent against the limit" with the amount line as its state description.

A change of state after the card appears is announced once through a polite live region, such as "AI spending limit: Close to the limit. $45.00 of $50.00 this month"; later changes of the amount are not announced.
Errors are the amount field's own error; the below-spent warning is a MonarchInlineNotice announced politely.
Removing the limit asks in an AlertDialog with a danger Remove limit and Keep limit.
Every button is a MonarchButton with a 48dp target; facts and rows wrap at large font sizes.
edgeCases: A limit of zero is always reached and draws no bar.
Spending over the limit reads "$2.10 over the limit"; the bar stays full.
Amounts in micros are rounded to the currency's digits when shown and when typed.
Currencies without minor units, such as JPY, show whole amounts.
A saved warn-at share the list cannot offer starts the form on the nearest choice.

examples.title: Edit, save and remove
examples.template:
CompositionLocalProvider(LocalConfiguration provides locale) {
    @OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
    MonarchAiSpendCap(
        spent = {{spent}},
        limit = settings.limit,
        currencyCode = {{currency}},
        period = MonarchAiSpendCapPeriod.{{period|pascal}},
        warnAt = settings.warnAt,
        behavior = settings.behavior,
        resetsAtMillis = {{resetsAt|millis}},
        breakdown = listOf(
            MonarchAiSpendCapBreakdownItem(id = {{breakdown.0.id}}, label = {{breakdown.0.label}}, spent = {{breakdown.0.spent}}),
            MonarchAiSpendCapBreakdownItem(id = {{breakdown.1.id}}, label = {{breakdown.1.label}}, spent = {{breakdown.1.spent}}),
            MonarchAiSpendCapBreakdownItem(id = {{breakdown.2.id}}, label = {{breakdown.2.label}}, spent = {{breakdown.2.spent}}),
        ),
        maxLimit = {{maxLimit}},
        timeZone = {{timeZone}},
        onSave = { settings = it },
    )
}
examples.code:
CompositionLocalProvider(LocalConfiguration provides locale) {
    @OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
    MonarchAiSpendCap(
        spent = 4200,
        limit = settings.limit,
        currencyCode = "GBP",
        period = MonarchAiSpendCapPeriod.Month,
        warnAt = settings.warnAt,
        behavior = settings.behavior,
        resetsAtMillis = 1_796_083_200_000L,
        breakdown = listOf(
            MonarchAiSpendCapBreakdownItem(id = "research", label = "Research agent", spent = 2310),
            MonarchAiSpendCapBreakdownItem(id = "summaries", label = "Meeting summaries", spent = 1245),
            MonarchAiSpendCapBreakdownItem(id = "drafting", label = "Email drafting", spent = 645),
        ),
        maxLimit = 50_000,
        timeZone = "UTC",
        onSave = { settings = it },
    )
}

examples.code:
